scope: Targeted primary-literature and preprint search; not an exhaustive bibliographic or patent search
queries_issued: DCLP3 REPLACE-BG hypoglycemia warning prediction C-peptide CLVer
CLVer C-peptide unwarned hypoglycemia prediction warning policy
TN10 AbATE gene 156 week restricted mean treatment biomarker
"From Forecasting Leaderboards to Deployment Decisions" glucose
"A Machine Learning Model for Week-Ahead Hypoglycemia Prediction" authors
query_result_note: Queries were issued in batches. No formal database hit counts or zero-result claims are inferred from the returned combined search view. Secondary websites were used only as discovery leads, not as support for technical claims.

sources_assessed.title: From Prediction to Practice: A Task-Aware Evaluation Framework for Blood Glucose Forecasting
sources_assessed.evidence: Sections 3.2, 3.4, 4 and AppendixA inspected. Reports event recall, warning lead time and false alarms per patient-day on DCLP3, DCLP5, PEDAP; uses separate participant train/validation/test splits for each cohort, short-gap interpolation, and a separate simulator action-analysis arm.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Direct precedent for task-aware evaluation and joint event/burden reporting. Does not contain REPLACE-BG or C-peptide and does not perform the specified frozen transfer plus CLVer analysis.

sources_assessed.title: Hypoglycemia event prediction from CGM using ensemble learning
sources_assessed.authors: Jesper Fleischer; Troels Krarup Hansen; Simon Lebech Cichosz
sources_assessed.evidence: Methods and event-based results inspected. Trains/tests on REPLACE-BG with patient splitting and hour-long history; sustained <70 mg/dL target; event recall, lead time and false positives; external SCGMS evaluation is synthetic.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Precludes claiming first event-based ensemble hypoglycemia evaluation or first REPLACE-BG prediction study. Does not train in DCLP3 and freeze transport to REPLACE-BG or analyze CLVer secretion.

sources_assessed.title: A Machine Learning Model for Week-Ahead Hypoglycemia Prediction From Continuous Glucose Monitoring Data
sources_assessed.evidence: Publisher abstract and indexed primary text inspected. Predicts next-week occurrence of sustained <54 mg/dL events, using REPLACE-BG, JDRF, Tidepool and external validation across cohorts.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: External real-cohort hypoglycemia prediction is established. Different forecast unit/horizon and cohorts; not the specified minute-scale frozen DCLP3 transport or linked CLVer endpoint analysis.

sources_assessed.title: Associations of CGM Metrics With Stimulated C-Peptide Measures in Youth With Recent-Onset Type 1 Diabetes
sources_assessed.evidence: Article abstract inspected: 103 CLVer children; compares CGM metrics and stimulated secretion at visits through 52 weeks; evaluates correlation and CGM-based prediction of a C-peptide threshold.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: The CLVer CGM/C-peptide association is prior work. The reported analysis is not forward event counts defined by a frozen DCLP3 warning policy with total-event, never-warning and conditional-warnability controls.

sources_assessed.title: Neutrophil-enriched gene signature correlates with teplizumab therapy resistance in different stages of type1 diabetes
sources_assessed.evidence: Results and Methods inspected. Derives 359 negatively correlated AbATE baseline genes; examines TN10 outcome correlations with placebo-associated genes excluded; integrates both cohorts to construct a 26-gene classifier.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Source of the signature and prior TN10 molecular analysis. No specified 312-gene unweighted standardized score, pooled-median four-cell 156-week additive treatment contrast, or CGM/CLVer combined program identified in inspected text.

sources_assessed.title: Improved Low-Glucose Predictive Alerts Based on Sustained Hypoglycemia: Model Development and Validation Study
sources_assessed.evidence: Missing-data and validation methods inspected. Feature-dependent missing records and dependent time-lagged records are excluded; sustained-low alerts evaluated with patient/time validation.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Precedent for sustained-low prediction and alert trade-offs. Different missing-history handling, cohort and endpoint; no specified combined analysis.

sources_assessed.title: Glycemic-aware metrics and oversampling techniques for predicting blood glucose levels using machine learning
sources_assessed.authors: Michael Mayo; Lynne Chepulis; Ryan G.Paul
sources_assessed.evidence: Preprocessing inspected: incomplete 24-reading windows discarded in OhioT1DM glucose regression.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Precedent for glycemic-region evaluation and history filtering; not frozen cross-cohort warning transport or secretion-conditioned endpoints.

sources_assessed.title: A Glycemia Risk Index (GRI) of Hypoglycemia and Hyperglycemia for Continuous Glucose Monitoring Validated by Clinician Ratings
sources_assessed.evidence: Indexed original methods inspected: combines 14-day traces from DIAMOND, DCLP3, REPLACE-BG, DIAMOND T2D to predict clinician rankings.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: Joint use of DCLP3 and REPLACE-BG itself is not new. This is trace-risk ranking rather than the specified frozen warning-policy transfer.

sources_assessed.title: From Forecasting Leaderboards to Deployment Decisions: A Fail-Closed Certification Protocol
sources_assessed.evidence: Abstract and full-text DCLP3 search inspected; focuses on fixed decision interfaces and deployment reversals, with Traffic-Hourly as anchor.
sources_assessed.priority_boundary: General deployment-gate/certification ideas have precedent. Not a clinical CGM/secretion/TN10 combined analysis.

assessment: The specified empirical combination is the narrow defensible priority target. Search did identify component precedents, including a 2026 DCLP3 task-aware evaluation preprint previously absent from the manuscript audit. No universal-first or first-publication assertion is established by this search.
proposed_priority_paragraph: UCP Technology LLC claims priority for the combined empirical analysis presented here and in its companion: retained observable hypoglycemic-event denominators during frozen DCLP3-to-REPLACE-BG warning-policy transport; paired warning gains, losses, opportunities and alarm burden; forward CLVer analysis of earlier secretion against later total and replay-unwarned events under the frozen DCLP3-selected M15 policy, with never-warning and conditional-warnability controls; and a separately reported TN10 treatment-by-score contrast in 156-week stage-3-free time using the fixed AbATE-derived gene set. This is the first report of that specified combination identified in our search of primary studies and preprints through 22 October 2026.
claim_exclusions: new theorem or mathematical nesting identity
first event-based or burden-aware CGM evaluation
discovery of the AbATE gene list or TN10 molecular response association
new patient data or causal biological unification
revision_guidance: Cite Namazi and Shakeri 2026 in main prior work; keep first claim tied to the precise combined analysis and documented search. TN10 companion endpoint remains the released-data contrast, with original follow-up provenance limitation retained.
